> Marcus — can you prepare a capacity estimate and a quick delta on pricing for the 200k bump?

Quick summary from infra side:

- Baseline (current): 500k inference units/mo committed
- Requested add: +200k inference units/mo (total committed 700k)
- Recommended configuration: reserve additional dedicated capacity (2 x p4-equivalent) with burst queue over hosted for peak ETL windows.

Estimated delta (list price model, before negotiated discounts):
- Unit rate (current): $0.0009 / inference unit
- Delta pricing for additional 200k: 200,000 * $0.00086 = $172.00 / month (note: example; final quote subject to contract tiering)
- One-time SOW amendment admin fee: $350

I attached a short spreadsheet with a month-by-month cost projection and a sample capacity schedule. If we move to 18 months, we can offer a modest step-down on unit price at committed thresholds.

Sean — finance will need to confirm whether we can apply the existing negotiated discount (4%) to the incremental units or if this is treated as a separate addendum.

Marcus
